summary: Full-text cross-review of the main four-source proof and the parameter refinement. Verified all actual fibers and origin-fiber regrouping; full dimension and Euclidean measure; every center case; proper ambient cut isolation; exact scalar certificates; finite padding; and the uniform strict supremum gap. Detected and verified correction of the intermediate k=1 display: the paid integer contribution is at most -R+k-1, and the total is at most 2k-R<0. Cross-checked all displayed rational margins against exact executable outputs. No unresolved gaps.
review_method: LLM cross-review by a co-developer of the source geometry and alternative parameter certificate, distinct from the author assembling the main note. This is supplementary review, not fully independent of the construction and not formal certification.
target_match_explanation: Approves the explicit n=76 counterexample to the specific 1/(e 2^n) assertion, with d=1372131+2^93 or d=1372129+2^94. This is not a refutation of the locked target asking for some smaller absolute positive constant. The earlier d=23 Lean theorem does not certify this new result.
